segment.source: Renders a centred opening band — eyebrow, headline, lead paragraph, a primary and a secondary action — with one wide product image sitting under the copy. Use it for: SaaS home pages, product launch pages, a relaunch announcement, any first screen whose job is to name the product and show it. Prefer 'Split Media Hero' when the screenshot has to sit beside the copy rather than under it, and 'Statement Hero' when there is no image at all.
